title: Personal Training Packages: purchase price, session count, and entry terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for every tier the company offers, the listed purchase price, the number of coaching sessions the tier grants at purchase, the length of each session, the club-membership entry requirement, and the number of days from purchase until unused sessions expire. These are the tier's own listed terms; how the price and grant are actually applied at purchase and activation is stated in the package purchase pricing basis and package activation documents.

## Tier reference table

| Tier | Listed price (USD) | Sessions granted | Session length (minutes) | Membership required to purchase | Minimum membership tier rank required | Days until unused sessions expire |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Single Session Pack | 65.00 | 1 | 55 | Yes | 0 (any active membership) | 30 |
| 5-Session Starter Pack | 300.00 | 5 | 55 | Yes | 0 (any active membership) | 90 |
| 10-Session Value Pack | 550.00 | 10 | 55 | Yes | 0 (any active membership) | 120 |
| 20-Session Performance Pack | 999.00 | 20 | 55 | Yes | 0 (any active membership) | 180 |
| Unlimited Monthly Coaching | 449.00 | Unlimited (recorded as -1 in the session count) | 45 | Yes | 0 (any active membership) | 30 |
| Elite Specialty Coaching | 1499.00 | 20 | 60 | Yes | 4 | 180 |

## Points of reference
Every tier of Personal Training Packages requires the purchasing member to hold an active club membership; five of the six tiers accept any active membership regardless of the member's tier rank on the club membership ladder, while Elite Specialty Coaching alone requires the member's own membership tier ladder rank to be at least 4. For example, a member whose membership ladder rank is 2 meets the entry requirement for the 10-Session Value Pack (which requires rank 0) but not for Elite Specialty Coaching (which requires rank 4 or higher).

Unlimited Monthly Coaching is the only tier that grants unlimited use rather than a fixed session count; its session count is recorded as -1 to denote unlimited access rather than a specific number of sessions. Every other tier grants a fixed, whole number of sessions at purchase. The expiration window is the number of calendar days from the purchase date within which the sessions granted must be used before they expire; it ranges from 30 days on the smallest packages to 180 days on the largest and most specialized packages.
